content: pgTAP latest release is v1.3.4 (2025-10-04, verified via GitHub API tags on theory/pgtap). Tested against PG 17.0. Runner is pg_prove (Perl, ships in TAP-Parser-SourceHandler-pgTAP CPAN dist, latest around 3.37+). Debian/Ubuntu PGDG apt repo ships postgresql-17-pgtap package (apt install postgresql-17-pgtap; CREATE EXTENSION pgtap).
